_comment: Single-purpose config: INCR-only, 2 tasksets, goal = measure INCR scheduler avg ET (Avg Sched Time in comparison_summary.csv). The incremental arm is INCR_Reopt_10 (reopt period 10 -- the same scheduler the bare INCR arm used to name; the gates read this arm). Use with: CONFIG_JSON=<this> ./scripts/run_end_to_end.sh (runs simulate -> sweep -> aggregate, in order).

test_mode._comment: 2 random 8-task tasksets, INCR_Reopt_10 only. 70s sim @ interval 10s => ~7 scheduling triggers; the C++ optimizer exec time is measured per trigger and averaged. Bump simulation_duration_seconds for a stabler mean.
test_mode._comment_on_single_task_figures: Single integer (NOT a list) picking which task count to use for 'slice' figures that are NOT vs-number-of-tasks: Fig 3 (important-task miss rate, aggregate_across_tasks.py) and the interval-sweep Fig 2 default (interval_sweep.py). Consumed ONLY by the sweep and aggregate stages -- the simulate stage ignores it entirely (simulate loops over num_tasks_for_cross_task_comparison instead). Must be a value present in num_tasks_for_cross_task_comparison, else those slice figures find no matching data and are skipped.

analysis._comment: Parameters controlling metric computation and data filtering.
